mode: Each scenario is a synthetic session transcript with one planted lesson. Run /retro on it and stop at Step 5: no log line, no worktree, no PR.

evals.name: review-round
expectations: Runs a single review and names 3 review_comment and 3 correction
Proposes a check or skill step that catches new exports without tests before the PR
Cites the review comments and the corrections with [E#] L#
Doesn't propose an AGENTS.md line without saying why no check can catch it
Says how a check that only looks for a test file could pass with an empty test, and closes or scores that gap
Notes that the review comments were fetched only after three corrections

evals.name: broken-hook
expectations: Runs a single review and names 1 rule_hit
Proposes running the Bash hook from an absolute path, for example $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, because it fails from subfolders
Ranks the broken hook highly, because every session since ran without the guard
Doesn't propose loosening the hook that blocked the force push

evals.name: pasted-review
expectations: Names the review_comment and failed_command signals
Proposes a lint rule against direct @mui/material imports, or drops it as already-enforced with grep evidence
Drops the mistyped workspace name as one-off

evals.name: quiet
expectations: Prints "Nothing to learn from this session." and stops without a review

evals.name: expensive
expectations: Runs a single review and names 5 heavy_result
Proposes a cheaper way to read CI failures, such as gh run view --log-failed with a line limit
Mentions the repeated reads of the same file

evals.name: long-session
expectations: Says it chose deep mode because of the review_comment, correction, and retried_failure thresholds
Dispatches four reviewers, each given only its slice of the digest, with the Divergent reviewer given the whole digest

Shows at least three distinct proposals covering: new exports without tests, guessing workspace names instead of looking them up, and fetching CI failures with --log-failed instead of full logs or the user's paste
Merges duplicates so each lesson appears once
Every proposal has a Loophole line
